# El.kz

> > El.kz is Kazakhstan's leading national news portal covering politics, society, culture, and international relations in Kazakh, Russian, and English.

El.kz serves as a comprehensive media platform for Kazakhstan, featuring news on government affairs, cultural heritage, business developments, and social issues. The portal celebrated its 10th anniversary as a trusted source for national and international coverage related to Kazakhstan.

## Key Topics

- Kazakhstan (Қазақстан/Казахстан)
- Astana (capital city)
- Almaty
- President Tokayev
- Kazakh culture and heritage
- International diplomacy
- National currency (tenge)
- Victory-80 (WWII anniversary)
- January events (Қаңтар оқиғасы)
- Education (bilim beru)
- Sports (Champions League, Olympics)
- Government appointments
- Business and digitalization
- Abay (cultural figure)
- Kandastar (diaspora)

## Politics & Government

- [Мемлекет басшысы Қазақстан халқына Жолдауын жариялайды](https://el.kz/memleket-basshysy-aza-stan-khal-yna-zholdauyn-zhariyalaydy_48021): President Tokayev's address to Kazakhstan people coverage
- [Политика](https://el.kz/ru/news/aqorda): Politics section covering Kazakhstan governance and international relations
- [Назначения](https://el.kz/ru/news/naznacheniya): Government appointments and personnel changes in Kazakhstan
- [On official visit of Kazakh FM to UAE](https://el.kz/en/on-official-visit-of-kazakh-fm-to-uae_54776): Kazakhstan FM Maksat Zhabagin's official visit to UAE coverage

## Society & Current Events

- [Society](https://el.kz/en/news/society): Society news covering social issues, volunteering, and demographics
- [Екібастұздағы жылу жүйесі қашан қалпына келеді](https://el.kz/ekibastuzdagy-zhylu-zhuyesi-qashan-qalpyna-keledi_57919): Heating system restoration in Ekibastuz amid emergency situation
- [Алдағы үш күнде 43 градусқа дейін аяз болады](https://el.kz/aldagy-ush-kunde-43-gradusqa-deyin-ayaz-bolady_57264): Weather forecast: temperatures dropping to -43°C in three days
- [Қаңтар оқиғасына қатысты көрме ұйымдастырылды](https://el.kz/qantar-oqigasyna-qatysty-korme-uyymdastyryldy_60482): January events exhibition organized in Elorda featuring weapons/police

## Culture & National Heritage

- [Бүгін - ұлттық валюта күні](https://el.kz/bugin-ulttyq-valyuta-kuni_55830): National Currency Day celebrating Kazakhstan's tenge (Nov 15)
- [Победа-80](https://el.kz/ru/news/pobeda-80): Victory-80: 80th anniversary of WWII victory news and celebrations
- [Қазақстан полициясына 25 жыл](https://el.kz/news/25_let_politsii_kazahstana): 25th anniversary of Kazakhstan police special coverage
- [Туған жер](https://el.kz/news/tugan-zher): Homeland travel section covering Kazakhstan tourism and culture
- [Кандастар](https://el.kz/ru/news/kandastar): Kandastar news archive on education, culture, and notable people

## Business & Economy

- [Бизнес](https://el.kz/ru/news/biznes): Business news covering entrepreneurs, startups, and digitalization

## Special Projects & Features

- [«El.kz» празднует 10-летие](https://el.kz/ru/elkz-prazdnuet-10-letie_54395): El.kz celebrates 10th anniversary as Kazakhstan media portal
- [Арнайы жобалар](https://el.kz/news/spetsproekti): Special projects on Kazakh culture, sports, and history
- [Balaqai](https://el.kz/specprojects/balaqai): Balaqai special project on children, education, and parenting
- [Interview](https://el.kz/en/news/interview): Interview archive featuring culture, diplomacy, and notable figures
- [Звезда интернера](https://el.kz/news/zvezda_internera): Internet personalities and Kazakh YouTube creators interviews
